title: Self-Documenting Types
concept: Well-named types (both aliases and variable names) make code explain itself without comments.
why: Code is read 10x more than it's written. Clear type names communicate intent instantly to anyone reading your code.
tips: If you need a comment to explain what a parameter is, make its type clearer
common_mistakes: Creating aliases for EVERYTHING — only alias when it adds meaning
Using abbreviations in type names: `Qty` instead of `Quantity`
